title: Bob Lazar on parallel engineering

tellings.quote: even if you talk to Bob Lazar and you go deep enough with him, it's not really reverse engineering, it's like parallel engineering.

related.note: Same subject as Lazar's S4 work, but the core claim is that it was parallel engineering rather than reverse engineering of crashed craft, which contradicts the story's account.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on alien craft at a secret site in the US. Michels says that if you talk to Lazar long enough, it turns out the work was not really copying the craft, which is called reverse engineering, but more like building similar machines alongside them, which he calls parallel engineering, an idea he also ties to Tom DeLonge, a musician behind a UFO book series called Sekret Machines. If true, it would mean the US was learning from alien technology and making its own versions.
